name: DaxLib.SVG.Data.Range
description: Computes min/max/baseline values from shaped scalar range inputs

parameters.name: includeZero
parameters.description: Use zero baseline when range is fully positive. Defaults to FALSE

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Data.Range' =
		(
			dataMin: NUMERIC VAL,
			dataMax: NUMERIC VAL,
			includeZero: BOOLEAN = FALSE()
		) =>

			VAR _IncludeZero = IF( ISBLANK( includeZero ), FALSE(), includeZero )
			VAR _Min = dataMin
			VAR _Max = dataMax
			VAR _Baseline = IF( _IncludeZero && _Min > 0, 0, _Min )

			RETURN
				ROW(
					"@Min", _Min,
					"@Max", _Max,
					"@Baseline", _Baseline
				)

    function 'DaxLib.SVG.Data.Range' =
    		(
    			dataMin: NUMERIC VAL,
    			dataMax: NUMERIC VAL,
    			includeZero: BOOLEAN = FALSE()
    		) =>
    
    			VAR _IncludeZero = IF( ISBLANK( includeZero ), FALSE(), includeZero )
    			VAR _Min = dataMin
    			VAR _Max = dataMax
    			VAR _Baseline = IF( _IncludeZero && _Min > 0, 0, _Min )
    
    			RETURN
    				ROW(
    					"@Min", _Min,
    					"@Max", _Max,
    					"@Baseline", _Baseline
    				)
